items.title: Kenny Davern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: So I quit him for six months and re-joined him a year later. I was one of the only few guys to ever re-join him. You know, when you left that band, you left.

ctx.x: Well that experience may have put some perspective on things for you.

I expected much more. From then on I just got very — like I said when I came home I said — oh boy they all said, you know, starry eyed, and thought I’d be stage struck. “How was it?” “It was the fucking worst” I said. Plain and simple. It was the fucking worst. Ohhhh. They all wanted to do that. And I had done it. So I didn’t see any romance to that whatsoever. So I quit him for six months and re-joined him a year later. I was one of the only few guys to ever re-join him. You know, when you left that band, you…
He was trying to get away from it.
